cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Truth or Loyalty
cards.instruction: Make someone choose between protecting the relationship and answering a dangerous question honestly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Mum's asking about the vase. I taught you to keep a promise before you could spell it. Are you still keeping the one you made me?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's blaming the cleaner. I can't let that happen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you remember not to let someone innocent take it. Clear her name. You don't have to give mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's asked me directly whether you broke it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then it's not a spelling exercise anymore. Are you telling her the truth, or keeping faith with the brother who taught you?
